Ahankari jahaj ahem ki ek lahar me doobta hai.
Sab kuch badal raha hai; kuch sthir nahi.
Ek teekhi baat vichar ka gehna hai.
Man chhaaiyon ka rangmanch hai.
Neend shanti ki chacheri bahan hai.
Shant darshak toofaan se pehle hava dekhta hai.
Ek chalak dhokha sadgun ka chola pehenta hai.
Gyaan chhupi hui sone se behtar hai.
Hum jeevan ki yatra anumanon ke samudra par karte hain.
Moorh suraj mein bhi dosh dhundhe.
Shaant paani anant ko pratibimbabit kare.
Teekhi buddhi sabse tez barbaadi se aage nikal jaati hai.
Vyang wo namak hai jo baasi aatma ko bachata hai.
Vichaar aatma ki boli hai.
Gyaani moorh ki bhi sune.
Gyan bhatakte dimaag ka langar hai.
Har phool ko gandagi se ugna padta hai.
Lalach rajaon ko dimaag ka bhikari bana deta hai.
Ujaala shaq ki chhaya se tez chale.
Buddhi darshanik ki aankhon ki chamak hai.
Langar sirf gahre paani mein tike.
Gyaan andhe ki aankh hai.
Rooh tab sunti hai jab duniya shaant hoti hai.
Teekha dimaag maya ke aar-paar nikal jata hai.
Moh bandhanon ki jad hai.
Dil wo wajehein jaanta hai jo tark ne kabhi nahi jaani.
Buddhi komal rooh ka kavach hai.
Hansi un zakhmon ko bharti hai jahan loha nahi pahunchta.
Vyang wo naavik hai jo pagalpan ke beech nikalta hai.
Jigyasa duniya ka kinaara dhoondh leti hai.
Gyan sadagi ka chola pehenta hai.
Garibi darshan ki bahan hai.
Dil ek aisa dhokebaaz hai jo dimaag ki nahi sunta.
Yaadein wo bachati hain jo waqt dafnaana chahta hai.
Log apne nazuk dil ke gird deewar banate hain.
Bheetar dekho; khazana gahra hai.
Sabra sabse jangli insaani toofan ko shaant karta hai.
Teekha dimaag sabse moti parda faad kar dekhta hai.
Hosh arajakta ke sath ek nazuk samjhauta hai.
Tark darshanik ka kavach hai.
Aatm-niyantran sabse bada samrajya hai.
Hum andar basne wali cheezon ko rokne ke liye deewar banate hain.
Andhere se mat daro, taare dhundho.
Jo thoda jaane, vah kisi par shaq na kare.
Shaanti se khaya gaya sadhan bhojan bhi tyohaar hai.
Buddhi insaani baat-cheet ka namak hai.
Chalak dhokebaaz har hawa ke sath chalta hai.
Hum beete kal ke pankho par aane wale kal ki taraf chalte hain.
Buddhi buddhi ki muskaan hai.
Aatma ka saamaan uske pachtave se naapa jata hai.
